backtest.assumptions: 0.05% slippage per trade, no commissions, current 293-stock universe (survivorship bias: delisted names excluded), dividends excluded
backtest.note: Monthly rebalance on last score date of each month; equal-weight top-10 by Quality Score; slippage 0.05% per buy/sell applied to traded notional. Caveats: survivorship bias (only current 293-stock universe — delisted/failed names that would have scored high are missing), dividends excluded, no commissions/taxes, scores use the same methodology across the full period (methodology drift not modeled), past performance does not predict future results. Not investment advice.
backtest.strategy: Top-10 Quality Score, equal-weight, monthly rebalance
